faq.q: How do I start an AI product video?
faq.a: Start with a product page or photo, tell the agent who it is for, approve the draft, and download the AI video. A bento box can be the example.

faq.q: How much detail should I give?
faq.a: Name the product and the one thing a buyer should notice, such as a lid that does not leak in a bag. A vague request for something nice gives you a vague clip. A clear photo of the whole item still helps.

faq.q: Can the clip look like a short news item?
faq.a: Yes. A supplement brand can have someone deliver one product fact in a steady voice, the way a desk update would. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You write the line so it stays a fact you can stand behind.

faq.q: What does the tool do with my note?
faq.a: It turns your note into a clip you can watch. For a kettle, that can mean the handle in frame and a person naming why the whistle matters. You can still change the line in the editor.

faq.q: What should a store expect before it picks a video tool?
faq.a: You get a file you can judge and a price you can see before it starts. You still decide whether the bottle looks like the one you ship.

faq.q: What do the voices sound like?
faq.a: Pick a brighter read or a steadier one. Play two against the same kettle line and keep the voice that fits the buyer. A cloned voice is only there if you have rights to the sample.

faq.q: Do I have to install an app first?
faq.a: No. You work in the browser. Captions and the music library are on the same page, and the file downloads with no watermark.

faq.q: Can the clip show a person speaking the line?
faq.a: Yes. Pick an AI actor who fits the buyer for that skincare jar, and a delivery that is calm rather than loud. It is still your ad. Do not present that actor as a customer who bought the jar.

faq.q: What changes for the team if the video is made here?
faq.a: The shoot comes off that week. A two-person shop can still put a new color of the lunch box on video without booking a crew.

faq.q: Are these clips useful in a paid campaign?
faq.a: Yes, as ads you label honestly. A brand can run the same serum with two openings and keep the one shoppers finish. When you need a real customer on camera, film that person for that one spot.

faq.q: Can the product's web address start the clip?
faq.a: Yes. A public page for a standing desk already has the photo and the name, and that page can open the ad. The same job also lives on the [product link to video](page:url-to-video) page.

faq.q: Can I test two openings of the same product?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the photo of the sneaker and change the first line. Post the version that matches the shoe you ship.

faq.q: Can the file run as a Facebook or Instagram ad?
faq.a: Yes. A 1:1 or 4:3 cut can go to those placements, and 9:16 can go to a Reel or to TikTok. Add any AI label the platform asks for. Do not present the AI actor as someone who bought the product.

faq.q: What should an ecommerce ad include?
faq.a: The product a shopper can buy, shown clearly, with a line you approve. AIVideosUGC starts that from your photo. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, and paid plans include commercial use. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Do I pick a video model by name?
faq.a: No. Describe the look, length, and frame, then judge the finished file. Open the tool that fits: motion from a still, a spoken ad, a demo, an unboxing, or an AI actor.

faq.q: When can I download the clip?
faq.a: After generation finishes. Captions and a voice come with the clip, and you can still change them in the editor. For a longer story, make a second clip and join the two there.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits. Premium is $63 for 600 credits. A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. If a clip fails, the credits come back.

definition.title: What Is This AI Video Generator for Products?
paras: A store takes the photo already on the listing and gets a clip a buyer can watch. Nobody on staff has to stand in, and you do not book a crew for that one product.
An agency can do the same for a client who needs a spoken ad. Choose an AI actor who fits that client, write the line in the language they sell in, and download the file.

reasons.h2: Why Shops Use an AI Video Generator for Products
reasons.lead: Spoken product clips, without putting a shoot on the week.

items.t: Match the Voice to the Script
items.d: A shopper can tell when the words and the mouth disagree. The line you approved is the line the face is saying, so the ad does not look dubbed.
The listing for a water bottle can open two different clips. Watch both and post the one that sounds like the brand.
A running shoe aimed at weekend joggers should not use a face from a formalwear ad. Pick the adult actor who could be that jogger.
